vfx_notes: Phoenix only. For parent 'attachment': add an Attachment to the character's body_part at attachment.position (part-local), set Attachment.Axis = axis and SecondaryAxis = secondary_axis, and parent the ParticleEmitter/PointLight to it (EmissionDirection 'Top' emits along the attachment's +Y = secondary_axis; 'Front' = all around for the swirl). For parent 'part': parent the emitter to that armour MeshPart (Shape Box fills it). NumberSequence keypoints are [time, value, envelope]; ColorSequence keypoints are [time, [r, g, b]] sRGB 0-255; ranges are [min, max]; Acceleration is world space. Upload textures/vfx/*.png and use their asset ids as Texture. At these rates about 300 particles are alive per player; halve Rate on low graphics quality. Glow parts: Neon, Color = color_srgb.
